title: The separating conjunction must exclude the type being isolated.
details: In Theorem7.17, implication (3)⇒(2), printed p.90, formulas φ_q are chosen only for q≠p, but the final displayed conjunction ranges over all q∈S_x(T). Its index must be q∈S_x(T) with q≠p. No φ_p was chosen; when p is the only type, the intended conjunction is empty and equals truth. The corpus uses exactly the corrected finite index set. This is an indexing slip, not a defect in the finite-isolation argument.
